chinese: 西锐入门

chinese: 西锐基础操控

english: Cirrus Advanced Handling
chinese: 西锐进阶操控

english: Cirrus Landing
chinese: 西锐着陆

english: Tesla Model 3 Test-Drive
chinese: 特斯拉 Model 3 试驾

english: Hey there, it's Austin Meyer, the author of X-Plane.
chinese: 嗨，我是 Austin Meyer，X-Plane 的作者。

english: Today, we're in a really nice plane, the Cirrus SR-22, and I'm going to show you how to fly it.
chinese: 今天我们在一架很棒的飞机里——西锐 SR-22，我来带你飞。

english: Be aware though, I am not touching the controls. You're gonna be flying. I'm just going to talk you through it on the radio.
chinese: 注意，我不会碰操纵杆。飞机由你来飞，我只在无线电里给你讲解。

english: We're going to start by getting your seat adjusted. Hit the [sim/general/forward] and [sim/general/backward] keys on your keyboard to scoot that seat forwards and backwards until you got it just where you want it.
chinese: 先调座椅：按 [sim/general/forward] 和 [sim/general/backward] 键，把座椅前后挪到你舒服的位置。

english: Now, hit the [sim/general/up] and [sim/general/down] keys to adjust your seat up or down. Maybe raise that seat a little so you can see over the dash a little better.
chinese: 再按 [sim/general/up] 和 [sim/general/down] 键把座椅调高调低，稍微抬高一点，越过仪表板看得更清楚。

english: Now, hit the [sim/general/rot_left] and [sim/general/rot_right] keys to look left and right. Take a look out at your wings, for example.
chinese: 按 [sim/general/rot_left] 和 [sim/general/rot_right] 键左右转头，比如看看机翼。

english: You might need to look up or down a bit. Hit the [sim/general/rot_up] and [sim/general/rot_down] keys to do that.
chinese: 有时还需要抬头或低头，按 [sim/general/rot_up] 和 [sim/general/rot_down] 键。

english: Okay, you can move around the cockpit like you need to. Let's take a look at this bird from the outside. Hit the [sim/view/circle] key to get an external circling view.
chinese: 好，座舱里可以随意移动了。到外面看看这架飞机：按 [sim/view/circle] 键切到外部环绕视角。

english: Hit the arrow keys to move around this airplane. Get behind the airplane so you can see the flaps back there on the back of the wing.
chinese: 用方向键绕着飞机移动，转到机尾一侧，就能看到机翼后缘的襟翼。

english: Let's set those flaps for takeoff, hit the [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] key, that's going to lower them down a notch. You can hit the [sim/flight_controls/flaps_up] key to retract him again, but I want one notch of flaps for takeoff.
chinese: 现在设定起飞襟翼：按 [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] 放下一档，按 [sim/flight_controls/flaps_up] 可以收回。起飞我要一档襟翼。

english: Okay, you don't seem to have a joystick, so we're gonna have to fly this thing with the mouse. You see that little rectangle in the center of the screen with the plus there in the middle? Click on that!
chinese: 看来你没接摇杆，只能用鼠标飞了。看到屏幕中间那个带加号的小方框了吗？点它！

english: When you grab that little plus icon with the mouse, that's basically like grabbing the stick of the airplane.
chinese: 用鼠标抓住这个加号，就相当于握住了飞机的驾驶杆。

english: Move your mouse around to move the flight controls. Look at the controls on the airplane move as you move the mouse. We can call this our pre-flight controls check.
chinese: 移动鼠标就是移动操纵面，注意看飞机上的舵面跟着动。这就算起飞前的操纵检查。

english: Click on that rectangle again to turn the stick loose. The controls are gonna stay where you left them.
chinese: 再点一次那个方框就松开驾驶杆，舵面会停在原处。

english: Alright, you've got a joystick, and hopefully you even calibrated it. Move it all around to see the controls move. We're gonna call this a pre-takeoff controls check.
chinese: 你接了摇杆，最好也校准过。把摇杆各方向都推一推，看舵面是否跟着动，这就是起飞前操纵检查。

english: Hit the [sim/view/default_view] key to get back in the cockpit.
chinese: 按 [sim/view/default_view] 键回到座舱视角。

english: Soon I'm going to ask you to control the speed of this airplane. First thing you've got to know is where the airspeed indicator is. Look at the primary flight display. It's right in front of you.
chinese: 接下来我会让你控制这架飞机的速度。首先要认识空速表：看正前方的主飞行显示器。

english: On the left side of the display is a tape, that's your airspeed. It's going to start showing numbers once you build up some speed and have some air pressure on that sensor.
chinese: 显示器左边那条带子就是空速，等你有速度、传感器感受到气压后才会显示数字。

english: Now, if I ever tell you you're going too fast, you better raise the nose. Go uphill to slow down.
chinese: 如果我说你太快了，就抬高机头，往上爬升减速。

english: If I ever tell you you're going too slow, lower that nose, build up some speed by coming downhill.
chinese: 如果我说你太慢了，就压低机头，往下俯冲增速。

english: One more note, when you add power, that big propeller up there is going to send a spiraling slip stream over this airplane and onto the vertical stabilizer. That is going to pull the airplane to the left.
chinese: 还有一点：加油门时，螺旋桨会在机身上卷起螺旋气流吹到垂尾上，把飞机往左带。

english: So get ready to move your controls to the right to hold this airplane on the center line.
chinese: 所以要准备好向右压杆，让飞机保持在跑道中线上。

english: Let's grab that control stick with your mouse and try our takeoff. Click in that rectangle to grab the stick.
chinese: 用鼠标抓住驾驶杆，我们准备起飞。点那个方框握住杆。

english: Take-off from Salzburg
chinese: 从萨尔茨堡起飞

english: And now, it's time to get this bird flying. Hit the [sim/flight_controls/brakes_toggle_max] key to turn the brakes off.
chinese: 现在让它飞起来：按 [sim/flight_controls/brakes_toggle_max] 键松开刹车。

english: Now, it looks like you don't have a joystick throttle, so you're going to have to go to full power with the keyboard. Push and hold the [sim/engines/throttle_up] key until that engine sounds like it's running as fast as it's going to run.
chinese: 你没有摇杆油门，就用键盘加满油门：按住 [sim/engines/throttle_up] 键，直到发动机声音到最大。

english: Remember, as you add power, that nose is going to pull to the left.
chinese: 记住，加油门时飞机会往左偏。

english: Oh good, it looks like you've got a throttle on your joystick. Go ahead and punch that throttle to wide open. As you add power, this bird is going to pull to the left.
chinese: 很好，你摇杆上有油门，直接推到底。加油门时这架飞机会往左偏。

english: Okay, we're coming up on 70 knots. Pull that nose up to about 10 degrees up.
chinese: 好，快 70 节了，把机头拉到抬头约 10 度。

english: Okay, we're going to about 70 knots. Pull that mouse back towards you to raise that nose up to about 10 degrees.
chinese: 好，到 70 节左右，用鼠标往后拉，把机头抬到约 10 度。

english: Hold those wings level, hold that nose about 10 degrees pitch up. I want to see about 80 knots of airspeed.
chinese: 保持机翼水平，机头保持 10 度上仰，我要看到空速大约 80 节。

english: We've got a little bit of altitude. Let's get rid of those flaps. Hit the [sim/flight_controls/flaps_up] key. Let's clean this airplane up.
chinese: 高度有了一点，把襟翼收起来：按 [sim/flight_controls/flaps_up] 键，让飞机干净一点。

english: Climb at around 100 knots
chinese: 以约 100 节爬升

english: Now I want 12 degrees pitch up, that's going to give us about 100 knots of climb speed.
chinese: 现在抬头到 12 度，这样爬升速度大约 100 节。

english: Whoa, whoa, whoa. It looks like you're pulling back on the throttle. I don't want you to do that. Get that throttle all the way forwards.
chinese: 喂喂喂，你好像在收油门，别收，把油门推到底。

english: Uh-oh, uh-oh, hold on, you're getting too slow. Lower that nose down to 12 degrees so we can build up some speed.
chinese: 哎哎，等等，速度太慢了。机头压低到 12 度，把速度提起来。

english: No, no, we're going too fast here. Get that nose up to about 12 degrees a pitch!
chinese: 不对不对，太快了，把机头抬到约 12 度上仰！

english: Yeah, this is what I like. About 12 degrees pitch up and 100 knots of climb. Perfect. Keep doing this.
chinese: 对，就是这样：12 度上仰、100 节爬升，完美，保持住。

english: Try some turns (left/right)
chinese: 试试转弯（左/右）

english: We got some altitude, looks like we're still alive, not too bad. Why don't you go ahead and lower the nose, build up some speed and try some turns.
chinese: 有高度了，看来还活着，不错。现在压低机头加点速度，试几个转弯吧。

english: So far, so good. Hit the [sim/view/still_spot] key.
chinese: 目前不错。按 [sim/view/still_spot] 键。

english: Yeeeeeeeeeeeeehaw!!!
Alright, it's time to get back to work. Hit the [sim/view/default_view] key.
chinese: 好，该干正事了，按 [sim/view/default_view] 键。

english: OK so now you got a few of the X-Plane keys and you can keep this thing right side up, so now you go fly on your own! Have fun!
chinese: 按键都熟了，也能把飞机飞稳，接下来自己上天飞吧！玩得开心！

english: OK let's learn how to get this Cirrus SR-22 around the sky properly! This is a great little plane, I love these things!
chinese: 好，我们来看看怎么把这架西锐 SR-22 飞明白！这架小飞机很棒，我很喜欢！

english: They're really efficient, they're fast enough, and their handling is just awesome.
chinese: 它很省油、速度也够快，操纵起来特别顺。

english: I'm gonna score you based on how you fly. If I give you a pitch, a speed, a heading... you fly it tight.
chinese: 我会按你的飞行来打分。我报俯仰、速度、航向，你就精准飞出来。

english: I want one notch of flaps for take-off. That's the [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] key. This will give you a little extra lift to get you going, without adding too much drag since we're only adding only one notch of flaps.
chinese: 起飞放一档襟翼，按 [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] 键。只放一档，多给点升力又不会增加太多阻力。

english: Brakes off! That's the [sim/flight_controls/brakes_toggle_max] key.
chinese: 松刹车！按 [sim/flight_controls/brakes_toggle_max] 键。

english: OK gimme full power. Remember, that prop is gonna pull you to the left. We're light on fuel today so this thing should have some get up and go!
chinese: 好，给满油门。记住螺旋桨会把飞机往左带。今天油量轻，这家伙会蹿得挺快！

english: Start raising the nose around 60 knots.
chinese: 60 节左右开始拉杆抬头。

english: OK hold that nose about 10 degrees up.
chinese: 好，保持机头约 10 度上仰。

english: Climb at 101 knots
chinese: 以 101 节爬升

english: OK we got 200 feet. Let's get rid of those flaps. Hit the [sim/flight_controls/flaps_up] key to clean those flaps up, and climb at 101 knots.
chinese: 好，到 200 英尺了，收起襟翼。按 [sim/flight_controls/flaps_up] 键收干净，以 101 节爬升。

english: You're a bit slow. Lower that nose a bit so we can build up some speed. I want 101 knots. [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up] and [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_down] will trim the nose up or down to make it easier.
chinese: 有点慢，机头压低一点加点速。我要 101 节。[sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up] 和 [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_down] 可以配平抬头或低头，会轻松些。

english: You're going too fast. Get that nose UP a bit to slow us down. I want 101 knots. [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up] and [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_down] will trim the nose up or down to make it easier.
chinese: 太快了，机头抬一点减速。我要 101 节。[sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up] 和 [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_down] 可以配平抬头或低头，会轻松些。

english: Let's keep a heading of 150 degrees. That's on the bottom of your primary display. [sim/general/forward] and [sim/general/backward] keys will scoot the seat fore and aft to maybe see that display a little better.
chinese: 保持 150 度航向，在主显示器下方。[sim/general/forward] 和 [sim/general/backward] 键前后挪座椅，能看得更清楚。

english: Yeah, this is what I like. 101 knots of climb. Perfect. Keep doing this up to 6,000 feet.
chinese: 对，就是这样：101 节爬升。完美，保持到 6000 英尺。

english: Hold 6,0000 feet
chinese: 保持6000英尺

english: OK now level off and hold 6,000 feet. Your altitude is on the right side of your primary flight display.
chinese: 好，现在改平，保持 6000 英尺。高度在主飞行显示器右侧。

english: Now bring that throttle back to cruise. About 65% or so on the power-indicator.
chinese: 现在把油门收到巡航，功率指示器上大约 65%。

english: You're too low! Pull up. I want 6,000 feet.
chinese: 太低！拉起来，我要 6000 英尺。

english: You're too high! Get that nose down. I want 6,000 feet.
chinese: 太高了！机头压低，我要 6000 英尺。

english: Yep this is what I like. 6,000 feet. You'll have to trim down a bit as the speed builds. [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up] and [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_down] keys will do the pitch trim.
chinese: 对，就这样，6000 英尺。速度上来后要慢慢配平低头。[sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up] 和 [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_down] 键就是俯仰配平。

english: Turn to the left
chinese: 向左转

english: OK let's try some turns. Give me 30 degrees of bank to the left.
chinese: 好，我们练练转弯，向左压 30 度坡度。

english: Get those wings over to the left. I want 30 degrees of bank to the left. Each tick-mark is 10 degrees.
chinese: 把机翼压向左，我要左坡度 30 度。每个刻度是 10 度。

english: Get those wings back closer to level. I want 30 degrees of bank to the left. Each tick-mark is 10 degrees.
chinese: 把机翼改回接近水平，我要左坡度 30 度。每个刻度是 10 度。

english: You're low. Pull up. I want 6,000 feet even in the turns.
chinese: 低了，拉起来，转弯时也要保持 6000 英尺。

english: You're high. Get that nose down. I want 6,000 feet even in the turns.
chinese: 高了，机头压低，转弯时也要保持 6000 英尺。

english: OK your bank looks good. Hold this. 30-left.
chinese: 好，坡度对了，保持住，左 30。

english: Turn to the right
chinese: 向右转

english: OK let's try a right turn. Give me 30 degrees to the right.
chinese: 好，再练右转，向右压 30 度。

english: Get those wings over to the right. I want 30 degrees of bank. Each tick-mark is 10 degrees.
chinese: 把机翼压向右，我要 30 度坡度。每个刻度是 10 度。

english: Get those wings back closer to level. I want 30 degrees of bank. Each tick-mark is 10 degrees.
chinese: 把机翼改回接近水平，我要 30 度坡度。每个刻度是 10 度。

english: You're low. Pull up. I want 6,000 feet even when turning.
chinese: 低了，拉起来，转弯时也要 6000 英尺。

english: You're high. Get that nose down. I want 6,000 feet even when turning.
chinese: 高了，机头压低，转弯时也要 6000 英尺。

english: Oh yeah, your bank looks awesome. Hold this. 30-right.
chinese: 好，坡度很棒，保持住，右 30。

english: Fly a heading of 330
chinese: 飞 330 航向

english: OK let's try some headings now. Turn heading 330. That's the little 33 on your compass down at the bottom of the primary flight display.
chinese: 好，练航向。转到 330。主飞行显示器最下面罗盘上那个 33 就是。

english: You're too low! Pull up. I wanna hold 6,000. We want heading and altitude at the same time!
chinese: 太低了！拉起来，保持 6000。航向和高度要同时保持！

english: You're too high! Get that nose down. I wanna hold 6,000. We want heading and altitude at the same time!
chinese: 太高了！机头压低，保持 6000。航向和高度要同时保持！

english: Come right to a heading of 330. [sim/general/forward] and [sim/general/backward] keys to scoot fore and aft to maybe see the heading better.
chinese: 右转到 330 航向。[sim/general/forward] 和 [sim/general/backward] 键前后挪座椅，看得更清楚。

english: Come left to a heading of 330. [sim/general/forward] and [sim/general/backward] keys to scoot fore and aft to maybe see the heading better.
chinese: 左转到 330 航向。[sim/general/forward] 和 [sim/general/backward] 键前后挪座椅，看得更清楚。

english: OK your heading and altitude look good. Hold this.
chinese: 好，航向和高度都不错，保持住。

english: OK let's do a descent.
chinese: 我们来练下降。

english: We climb at a certain airspeed, but we descend at a certain descent rate, in feet per minute.
chinese: 爬升看空速，下降看下降率，单位是英尺每分钟。

english: We climb at a certain airspeed to get the best performance out of the airplane.
chinese: 爬升时保持某个空速，飞机性能最好。

english: But we descend at a certain descent rate to hit our altitudes on time!
chinese: 下降时保持某个下降率，才能按时到达高度！

english: Descend at 1,500 fpm
chinese: 1500英尺/分下降

english: So I want you to descend at exactly 1,500 feet per minute. The vertical speed indicator is by the altitude tape.
chinese: 我要你精确按 1500 英尺/分下降。垂直速度表在高度带旁边。

english: Hold this heading, and chop the power to idle.
chinese: 保持这个航向，油门收到慢车。

english: You're coming down to fast. Get that nose up a bit. I want 1,500 feet per minute down. Vertical speed is right side of primary display.
chinese: 下降太快了，机头抬一点，我要 1500 英尺/分。垂直速度在主显示器右侧。

english: You're not really descending. Get that nose down a bit. I want 1,500 feet per minute down. Vertical speed is right side of primary display.
chinese: 你几乎没在下降，机头压低一点，我要 1500 英尺/分。垂直速度在主显示器右侧。

english: Come right to a heading of 330. You gotta come to the right here.
chinese: 右转到 330 航向，这里得往右。

english: Come left to a heading of 330. You gotta come to the left here.
chinese: 左转到 330 航向，这里得往左。

english: Oh awesome! Your heading and descent rate are looking great. Hold this.
chinese: 太棒了！航向和下降率都很好，保持住。

english: All right now let's try something called minimum controllable airspeed at 4,000 feet.
chinese: 好，接下来练「最小可控速度」，高度 4000 英尺。

english: We're gonna get this thing as slow as we can. You'll notice the plane feels heavier when you barely have enough air moving over it to keep it aloft.
chinese: 我们要尽量飞慢。当流过机翼的空气刚够托住飞机时，你会觉得飞机变沉了。

english: You'll hit the [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] key for each notch of flaps (there's two notches of flaps in this plane) and the [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up] [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_down] keys to trim up and down. Trimming up will make this way easier.
chinese: 每放一档襟翼按一次 [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] 键（这架飞机有两档），用 [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up]、[sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_down] 键配平。往上配平会轻松很多。

english: Hold 4,000 feet

So OK give me full flaps (the [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] key, hit twice) and slow down to 55 knots indicated. Hold 4,000 feet. [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up] key to trim up so you don't have to pull on the stick.
chinese: 好，放满襟翼（按两次 [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down]），表速减到 55 节，保持 4000 英尺。按 [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up] 往上配平，就不用一直拉杆了。

english: You're too fast. I want 55 knots. [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up] to trim up. You want to trim for 55 knots without touching the stick.
chinese: 太快了，我要 55 节。按 [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up] 往上配平，目标是不动杆就稳在 55 节。

english: You're too slow. I want 55 knots. [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_down] to trim down. You want to trim for 55 knots without touching the stick.
chinese: 太慢了，我要 55 节。按 [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_down] 往下配平，目标是不动杆就稳在 55 节。

english: You're low. Add power to climb. Power will pull you up higher. I want 4,000 feet.
chinese: 低了，加油门爬升，油门会把你拉起来。我要 4000 英尺。

english: You're high. Ease off the power. Less power will let you settle. I want 4,000 feet.
chinese: 高了，收点油门，少点功率就会沉下来。我要 4000 英尺。

english: Yes! Hold this. 55 knots and 4,000 feet. Trim with [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up] and [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_down] to hold 55 knots. Adjust throttle to hold 4,000 ft.
chinese: 对！保持住：55 节、4000 英尺。用 [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up]、[sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_down] 配平保持 55 节，用油门保持 4000 英尺。

english: Land at Salzburg Airport
chinese: 萨尔茨堡机场降落

english: Whew! OK get your power on, your flaps up, and experiment with landing this thing on your own.
chinese: 呼！好，加上油门，收起襟翼，自己试着把这架飞机落下来。

english: You've got a map on the right-side display to find the airport. Arrow keys or [sim/general/rot_left]/[sim/general/rot_right]/[sim/general/rot_up]/[sim/general/rot_down] to move around to see the map better. Good luck!
chinese: 右侧显示器有地图，可以找机场。方向键或 [sim/general/rot_left]/[sim/general/rot_right]/[sim/general/rot_up]/[sim/general/rot_down] 移动视角，看地图更方便。祝你好运！

english: We're going to fly new maneuvers, starting with best angle of climb departure, to clear terrain and obstacles.
chinese: 接下来练新科目，先练「最佳爬升角起飞」，用来越过地形和障碍物。

english: Your initial climb will be 78 knots: You'll have to hold that up about 10 degrees.
chinese: 起始爬升 78 节，机头大概抬 10 度。

english: One notch of flaps for take-off.
chinese: 起飞放一档襟翼。

english: Brakes off!
chinese: 松刹车！

english: Full power! We got a light fuel load today so this thing should move quick.
chinese: 满油门！今天油量轻，这家伙会跑得很快。

english: Start the nose up at about 60 knots.
chinese: 60 节左右开始抬头。

english: Climb at 78 knots
chinese: 以 78 节爬升

english: I want 78 knots! That's best angle of climb. This takes us up at the steepest angle.
chinese: 我要 78 节！这是最佳爬升角，能以最陡的角度上升。

english: OK we got 200 feet. Clean up the plane. Flaps up, but hold 78 knots!
chinese: 好，到 200 英尺了，收起襟翼，但保持 78 节！

english: You're a little slow. Lower that nose a bit so we can build up some speed. I want 78 knots. That's best angle of climb.
chinese: 有点慢，机头压低一点加点速。我要 78 节，这是最佳爬升角。

english: You're going too fast. Get that nose UP to slow us down. I want 78 knots. That's gonna give your your best angle of climb.
chinese: 太快了，机头抬一点减速。我要 78 节，这才是最佳爬升角。

english: Let's keep a heading of 150 degrees. That's on the bottom of your primary display.
chinese: 保持 150 度航向，在主显示器下方。

english: Yeah, this is what I like. 78 knots of climb. Steepest-angle. Keep doing this.
chinese: 对，就是这个：78 节爬升，最陡角度。继续。

english: OK now I want best rate of climb! This takes us up at the best climb rate. That's 101 knots in this plane.
chinese: 好，现在练最佳爬升率！这样爬升最快，这架飞机是 101 节。

english: You're a bit slow. Lower that nose a bit so we can build up some speed. I want 101 knots. That's best rate of climb. [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_down] to trim down.
chinese: 有点慢，机头压低一点加点速。我要 101 节，这是最佳爬升率。按 [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_down] 往下配平。

english: You're going too fast. Get that nose UP to slow us down. I want 101 knots. That's best rate of climb. [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up] to trim up.
chinese: 太快了，机头抬一点减速。我要 101 节，这是最佳爬升率。按 [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up] 往上配平。

english: Let's keep a heading of 150 degrees. That's on the bottom of of the primary flight display.
chinese: 保持 150 度航向，在主飞行显示器下方。

english: Yep. 101 knots of climb. Speed for best rate of climb. Keep doing this to 6,000 feet.
chinese: 对，101 节爬升，最佳爬升率速度。保持到 6000 英尺。

english: Hold 6,000 feet
OK get us level at 6,000 feet.
chinese: 好，改平到 6000 英尺。

english: OK now let's try some steep turns. Give me 60 degrees of bank to the left. Hold 6,000 feet.
chinese: 好，练大坡度盘旋。向左压 60 度坡度，保持 6000 英尺。

english: Get those wings over to the left. I want 60 degrees of bank to the left. 60 degrees is that second large tick-mark on the PFD.
chinese: 把机翼压向左，左坡度 60 度。PFD 上第二个大刻度就是 60 度。

english: Get those wings back closer to level. I want 60 degrees of bank to the left. 60 degrees is that second large tick-mark on the PFD.
chinese: 把机翼改回接近水平，左坡度 60 度。PFD 上第二个大刻度就是 60 度。

english: OK this looks good. Hold 60-left and 6,000 feet. This is 2Gs of flight by the way.
chinese: 好，保持左 60、6000 英尺。这是 2G 的机动。

english: OK let's try a steep turn to the right! Give me 60 degrees bank to the right. Hold 6,000 feet.
chinese: 好，再来个大坡度右转！右坡度 60 度，保持 6000 英尺。

english: Get those wings over to the right. I want 60 degrees of bank. 60 degrees is that second large tick-mark on the PFD.
chinese: 把机翼压向右，坡度 60 度。PFD 上第二个大刻度就是 60 度。

english: Get those wings back closer to level. I want 60 degrees of bank. 60 degrees is that second large tick-mark on the PFD.
chinese: 把机翼改回接近水平，坡度 60 度。PFD 上第二个大刻度就是 60 度。

english: You're low. Pull up. I want 6,000 feet even in these steep turns.
chinese: 低了，拉起来，大坡度转弯时也要 6000 英尺。

english: You're high. Get that nose down. I want 6,000 feet even in these steep turns.
chinese: 高了，机头压低，大坡度转弯时也要 6000 英尺。

english: OK your bank looks good. Hold 60-right and 6,000 feet.
chinese: 好，坡度不错。保持右 60、6000 英尺。

english: OK let's try some headings now. Turn heading 330. That's the little 33 on your compass at the bottom of the primary flight display.
chinese: 好，练航向。转到 330。主飞行显示器最下面罗盘上那个 33 就是。

english: You're too low! Pull up. I wanna hold 6,000. I want heading and altitude at the same time!
chinese: 太低了！拉起来，保持 6000。航向和高度要同时保持！

english: You're too high! Get that nose down. I wanna hold 6,000. We can hold heading and altitude at the same time!
chinese: 太高了！机头压低，保持 6000。航向和高度可以同时保持！

english: Remember we climb at the most-efficient speed for the airplane, that's the best rate of climb we practiced earlier.
chinese: 记住爬升要用飞机最省时的速度，也就是刚才练的最佳爬升率。

english: But we descend at a certain descent rate to hit our target altitudes when we want.
chinese: 而下降要保持某个下降率，才能按时到达目标高度。

english: Let's do a steep descent.
chinese: 来个大下降率下降

english: Descend at 2,000 fpm
chinese: 2000英尺/分下降

english: Descend at exactly 2,000 feet per minute.
chinese: 精确按 2000 英尺/分下降。

english: Hold heading 330, and chop power to idle!
chinese: 保持 330 航向，油门收慢车！

english: You're coming down to fast. Get that nose up a bit. I want 2,000 feet per minute down.
chinese: 下降太快了，机头抬一点，我要 2000 英尺/分。

english: You're not really descending. Get that nose down a bit. I want 2,000 feet per minute down.
chinese: 你几乎没在下降，机头压低一点，我要 2000 英尺/分。

english: OK your heading and descent rate are looking good. Hold this.
chinese: 好，航向和下降率都不错，保持住。

english: Hold 4,000 ft
OK let's do minimum controllable airspeed with some turns at 4,000 feet.
chinese: 好，在 4000 英尺练「最小可控速度」，再加点转弯。

english: The idea is we can still maneuver the airplane when we're going slow.
chinese: 目的是低速时还能操纵飞机。

english: Remember this is a million times easier if you use [ and ] to trim for speed, and use power to ease your altitude up and down. Propwash over the tail will give you way more pitch control!
chinese: 记住：用 [ 和 ] 配平速度、用油门微调高度，会轻松一万倍。螺旋桨洗流吹到尾翼上，俯仰控制会好很多！

english: Now give me full flaps, 55 knots, hold 4,000 feet, heading 330.
chinese: 满襟翼，55 节，4000 英尺，航向 330

english: You're low. Add power to get up there. Power will pull you up higher. I want 4,000 feet.
chinese: 低了，加油门爬上去，油门会把你拉高。我要 4000 英尺。

english: Come right to a heading of 150. You gotta come to the right here.
chinese: 右转到 150 航向，这里得往右。

english: Come left to a heading of 150. You gotta come to the left here.
chinese: 左转到 150 航向，这里得往左。

english: Perfect. 55 knots and 4,000 feet. Trim with [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up] and [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_down] for 55 knots. Adjust throttle to hold 4,000 ft.
chinese: 完美：55 节、4000 英尺。用 [sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_up]、[sim/flight_controls/pitch_trim_down] 配平保持 55 节，用油门保持 4000 英尺。

english: Now turn left to 150 degrees. You'll need to add some power in the turn.
chinese: 现在左转到 150 度，转弯中要加点油门。

english: All right that was fine let's get back to regular flight. Level the nose and wings, and go to full power!
chinese: 好，刚才不错，回到正常飞行。机头机翼改平，推满油门！

english: Now that we have full power and some speed, it's safe to retract the flaps.
chinese: 现在有满油门和速度了，可以安全收襟翼。

english: Now go to heading 150, 4,000 feet, and set power for 135 knots.
chinese: 现在飞 150 航向、4000 英尺，调油门到 135 节。

english: Perform a chandelle
chinese: 做一个 Chandelle

english: Now we'll do a Chandelle. That's nose 20 degrees up, bank 30 degrees right, through 180 degrees of turn at full power.
chinese: 现在做一个 Chandelle：机头 20 度上仰、右坡度 30 度、满油门转 180 度。

english: So when I say, firewall the throttle, bring that nose to 20 degrees up, bank to 30 degrees right, and fly to a heading of 330.
chinese: 所以我说「满油门」时，把机头拉到 20 度、右坡度 30 度，飞到 330 航向。

english: Now! Chandelle! 20 degrees up, 30 degrees right, full power!
chinese: 现在！Chandelle！20 度上仰、右 30、满油门！

english: 20 degrees up, 30 degrees right, full power to heading 330!
chinese: 20 度上仰、右 30、满油门飞到 330 航向！

english: OK, that was a Chandelle.
chinese: 这就是 Chandelle。

english: Let's do another! Go to heading 330, 5,000 feet, 135 knots with power.
chinese: 再来一个！先到 330 航向、5000 英尺、135 节。

english: Now we'll do a Chandelle to the left. That's nose 20 degrees up, bank 30 degrees left, through 180 degrees of turn at full power.
chinese: 现在做向左的 Chandelle：机头 20 度上仰、左坡度 30 度、满油门转 180 度。

english: So when I say, firewall the throttle, bring that nose to 20 degrees up, 30 degrees bank left, and fly to heading 150.
chinese: 我说「满油门」时，机头 20 度、左坡度 30 度，飞到 150 航向。

english: Now! Chandelle! 20-up, 30-left, full power!
chinese: Chandelle！上仰20、左30、满油门！

english: 20-up, 30-left, full power to heading 150!
chinese: 仰 20、左 30、满油门飞向 150！

english: OK, that was a Chandelle! Just do free-flight on your own now, maybe try to land!
chinese: 好，这就是 Chandelle！接下来自由飞吧，试试降落。

english: Let's do a touch-n-go.
chinese: 我们来练连续起降

english: A touch-n-go is a landing followed by full power to get right back up in the air again!
chinese: 连续起降就是落地后马上满油门再飞起来！

english: We'll do a touch-n-go and then a full-stop landing. They topped off the tanks, so we're gonna feel a little heavier today.
chinese: 我们先做一次连续起降，再做一次全停着陆。今天油箱加满了，会感觉重一些。

english: All right let's go. One notch of flaps! Brakes off! Full power!
chinese: 好，开始。一档襟翼！松刹车！满油门！

english: At around 60 knots, start raising the nose up to 10 degrees.
chinese: 60 节左右，机头抬到 10 度。

english: I want 78 knots, best angle of climb, to get us clear of trees and stuff like that.
chinese: 我要 78 节，最佳爬升角，先把树和障碍物越过去。

english: Flaps up!
chinese: 收襟翼！

english: Now that we're clear of obstacles, I want best rate of climb. That's 101 knots.
chinese: 越过障碍了，改用最佳爬升率，101 节。

english: Now turn crosswind. Left to heading 60 degrees.
chinese: 现在转侧风：左转到 60 度航向。

english: Level off at 2,400 feet. 40% power,
chinese: 改平 2400 英尺，40% 功率。

english: Now turn downwind. Left to heading 330 degrees, 40% power
chinese: 现在转下风：左转到 330 度航向，40% 功率。

english: We're now abeam the numbers. 1 notch of flaps, 15% power.
chinese: 现在正对跑道头：一档襟翼，15% 功率。

english: Now turn base. Full flaps. Left to heading 240 degrees, 15% power.
chinese: 现在转底边，满襟翼，左转 240 度，15% 功率。

english: Now turn final. Left turn to the runway.
chinese: 现在转五边：左转对准跑道。

english: You're on upwind. I want heading 150, climb at 101 knots.
chinese: 你在上风边。航向 150，以 101 节爬升。

english: You're on crosswind. I want heading 60, climb at 101 knots.
chinese: 你在侧风边。航向 60，以 101 节爬升。

english: You're on crosswind. I want heading 60, 2,400 feet, 40% power.
chinese: 你在侧风边。航向 60，2400 英尺，40% 功率。

english: Set 40% on the power indicator.
chinese: 功率指示器设到 40%。

english: Turn right to a heading of 330.
chinese: 右转到 330 航向。

english: Turn left to a heading of 330.
chinese: 左转到 330 航向。

english: You're a bit low. Get up to 2,400 feet.
chinese: 有点低，爬回 2400 英尺。

english: You're a bit high. Get down to 2,400 feet.
chinese: 有点高，降到 2400 英尺。

english: OK this is good. Heading 330, 2,400 feet.
I want one notch of flaps. Hit the [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] key.
chinese: 我要一档襟翼，按 [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] 键。

english: Ooops you have full flaps. I only want one notch. Hit the [sim/flight_controls/flaps_up] key.
chinese: 哎，你放满了，我只要一档。按 [sim/flight_controls/flaps_up] 键收一档。

english: Remember I want 15% on that power indicator.
chinese: 记住功率指示器要 15%。

english: Right to 330.
chinese: 右到 330

english: Left to 330.
chinese: 左到 330

english: You're coming down too fast. Give me 500 feet per minute.
chinese: 下降太快了，给我 500 英尺/分。

english: You're not coming down. Give me 500 feet per minute.
chinese: 你没在下降，给我 500 英尺/分。

english: OK this is good. Heading 330, coming down at 500 feet per minute.
chinese: 好，就这样：330 航向，500 英尺/分下降。

english: Full flaps. Hit the [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] key.
chinese: 满襟翼：[sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] 键。

english: Set 15% on that power indicator.
chinese: 功率指示器设到 15%。

english: You're off heading. Turn right to 240.
chinese: 航向偏了，右转到 240。

english: You're off heading. Turn left to 240.
chinese: 航向偏了，左转到 240。

english: You're a little low. Let's descend a bit less.
chinese: 有点低，下降率放小一点。

english: You're a little high. Let's get down a bit quicker.
chinese: 有点高，下降快一点。

english: Looking good. 15% power, heading 240, gentle descent.
chinese: 不错：15% 功率、240 航向、平缓下降。

english: Vref, or reference approach speed, is 85 knots. Hold that.
chinese: Vref（基准进近速度）85 节，保持住。

english: See those lights to the left side of the runway? Those are PAPI lights. I want two of those to be white, and two of them to be red.
chinese: 看到跑道左侧那排灯了吗？那是 PAPI 灯。我要两白两红。

english: Fly up to make the PAPI lights white. Fly down to make them red. White over white, you're all right. Red over red... yer dead!
chinese: 往上飞灯变白，往下飞灯变红。白白你就稳，红红……就没命了！

english: Let's get those flaps all the way down. [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] key.
chinese: 把襟翼全放下来，按 [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] 键。

english: You're a bit left of the runway. I would come right.
chinese: 偏跑道左侧了一点，往右修。

english: You're a bit right of the runway. I would come left.
chinese: 偏跑道右侧了一点，往左修。

english: You're drifting a bit right. I would come left.
chinese: 有点往右漂，往左修。

english: You're drifting a bit left. I would come right.
chinese: 有点往左漂，往右修。

english: You're a bit low. Climb until half the PAPI lights are white.
chinese: 有点低，爬到 PAPI 灯一半白。

english: You're a bit high. Descend until half the PAPI lights are red.
chinese: 有点高，降到 PAPI 灯一半红。

english: You're a bit slow. I want 85 knots.
chinese: 有点慢，我要 85 节。

english: You're a bit fast. I want 85 knots.
chinese: 有点快，我要 85 节。

english: OK this is looking good.
chinese: 好，看起来不错。

english: Chop power and ease the nose up to touch down at 60 knots!
chinese: 收油门，机头轻抬，以 60 节接地！

english: You were going way fast. That's hard on the tires and floats on the wing.
chinese: 你太快了，轮胎和机翼都受不了。

english: You were going too fast. That's hard on the tires and floats on the wing.
chinese: 你太快了，轮胎和机翼都受不了。

english: You were going fast. That's hard on the tires and increases stopping distance.
chinese: 速度快了，费轮胎也拉长刹车距离。

english: You were going a bit fast. That increases stopping distance.
chinese: 有点快，刹车距离会变长。

english: That sucked!
chinese: 太糟了！

english: That was a hard landing.
chinese: 这着陆太重了。

english: That was a little rough.
chinese: 有点颠。

english: Not too bad for smoothness there.
chinese: 平稳度还凑合。

english: Pretty decent for smoothness there.
chinese: 平稳度相当不错。

english: Hey that was pretty good touch-down!
chinese: 嘿，这一下接地挺漂亮！

english: Take-off from Solzburg
chinese: 从萨尔茨堡起飞

english: OK let's go! Flaps up a notch! Full power!
chinese: 好，走！襟翼收一档！满油门！

english: Taxi to parking position
chinese: 滑行到停机位

english: OK get this thing slowed down and taxi in.
chinese: 好，把速度降下来，滑进去。

english: Well, I guess we're still alive.
chinese: 嗯，看来我们还活着。

english: Watch YouTube video
chinese: 看 YouTube 视频

english: I'm gonna show you a YouTube video showing how to start this thing.
chinese: 我先给你看段 YouTube 视频，讲讲怎么启动这家伙。

english: Start engine
chinese: 启动引擎

english: OK, now you do it!
chinese: 现在你来！

english: Hit [sim/general/rot_left]/[sim/general/rot_right]/[sim/general/rot_up]/[sim/general/rot_down] or arrow keys and [sim/general/forward] [sim/general/backward] keys so you are looking at the entire instrument panel.
chinese: 按 [sim/general/rot_left]/[sim/general/rot_right]/[sim/general/rot_up]/[sim/general/rot_down] 或方向键，再用 [sim/general/forward] [sim/general/backward] 键，让整个仪表板都在视野里。

english: OK this is where I teach everybody that uses X-Plane how to steal my airplane. First hit the battery switches BAT 1 and BAT 2 on the upper left of the panel.
chinese: 好，我就是在这儿教所有飞 X-Plane 的人怎么偷我的飞机。先按面板左上角的 BAT 1 和 BAT 2 电瓶开关。

english: So we got power. Now hit the DC POWER button right below the BAT 2.
chinese: 有电了。现在按 BAT 2 正下方的 DC POWER 按钮。

english: You got the systems. I got the G1000. Now, hit the DOOR SEALS button on the very lower-left of the panel.
chinese: 系统有电了，我这儿有 G1000。现在按面板最左下角的 DOOR SEALS 按钮。

english: Now the cabin's air-tight. Hit the igniters, the next switch over from the door-seals.
chinese: 现在座舱气密了。按点火开关，就在门封开关旁边那个。

english: So we got spark in the engine. Hit the fuel pumps so we got some jet-fuel pushing.
chinese: 发动机有点火了。按燃油泵，让燃油开始供上。

english: Not one drop of fuel has entered the engine yet! If it did, the engine would melt!
chinese: 现在还一滴油都没进发动机！要是进了，发动机会烧化的！

english: We gotta get plenty of compressor RPM to get airflow through this engine before we add fuel! The rushing air will form an insulating wall between the flame and the case of the engine!
chinese: 加燃油之前得先把压气机转速提起来，让空气流过去！高速气流会在火焰和机匣之间形成一层隔热墙！

english: So you hold that big red starter button, and I'll engage the fuel condition lever once we get to 16% compressor RPM!
chinese: 你按住那个大红启动按钮，压气机转速到 16% 我就接通燃油！

english: Hold that starter! I'm engaging the fuel!
chinese: 按住启动按钮！我在接燃油！

english: Hold that starter until we get enough airflow for the engine temperature to come down!
chinese: 按住启动，等气流够了、发动机温度降下来！

english: OK now un-feather the prop for flight! Push the blue knob at the bottom of the panel all the way forwards! Hit the [sim/general/rot_down] key to look down if you need to!
chinese: 好，现在把螺旋桨解除顺桨！把面板下方那个蓝色手柄推到最前！需要的话按 [sim/general/rot_down] 往下看！

english: OK generator and alternator on! Those switches are just below the batteries!
chinese: 好，发电机和交流发电机接通！开关就在电瓶下面。

english: Now let's get some lights. Hit the NAV and STROBE and LANDING lights, they're just to the right of the starter.
chinese: 现在开灯。按 NAV、STROBE 和 LANDING 灯，就在启动按钮右边。

english: Now we need pressurization. Hit the BLEED AIR button to the right of the lights. This is gonna take some high pressure air out of the engine, and send it into the cabin.
chinese: 现在需要增压。按灯右边的 BLEED AIR 按钮，把发动机的高压引气送进座舱。

english: OK headsets on! Now hit the [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] key or hit the flap lever to get one notch of flaps.
chinese: 好，戴好耳机！现在按 [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] 键或拨襟翼手柄，放一档襟翼。

english: Hit W or right-mouse-drag to get your view set for take-off, and then: Brakes off!
chinese: 按 W 或右键拖动设好起飞视角，然后：松刹车！

english: Add power to get 1200 ft-lb of torque. That's about HALF power, which we use for take-off so we don't run out of rudder authority as that prop pulls us off to the left.
chinese: 加油门到 1200 英尺磅扭矩，大约是半功率。起飞用半功率，免得螺旋桨把飞机往左带、方向舵不够用。

english: Start the nose up at 60 knots. I'll want 10 degrees up.
chinese: 60 节开始抬头，我要 10 度上仰。

english: Climb at 10 degrees
chinese: 以 10 度爬升

english: I want 10 degrees nose-up! That's a little faster than best-angle, so we don't run out of aileron authority!
chinese: 我要 10 度上仰！比最佳爬升角稍快，免得副翼不够用！

english: Gear up! [sim/flight_controls/landing_gear_toggle] key or the handle right in front of you!
chinese: 收起落架！按 [sim/flight_controls/landing_gear_toggle] 键或拉前面的手柄！

english: Climb at 120 knots
chinese: 以 120 节爬升

english: OK we got 200 feet! Flaps up! 120 knots! 150 degree heading!
chinese: 好，到 200 英尺！收襟翼！120 节！航向 150！

english: You're a bit slow. Lower that nose a bit so we can build up some speed. I want 120 knots. That's your enroute climb speed.
chinese: 有点慢，机头压低一点加点速。我要 120 节，这是航路爬升速度。

english: You're going too fast. Get that nose up to slow us down. I want 120 knots. That's your enroute climb speed.
chinese: 太快了，机头抬一点减速。我要 120 节，这是航路爬升速度。

english: Torque's falling off as we climb into thinner air! Advance the throttle to hold 1200 ft-lb. That's shown at the top-left of the right-hand display.
chinese: 爬升到稀薄空气里扭矩会掉！加油门保持 1200 英尺磅，右侧显示器左上角能看到。

english: Torque's a bit high. Pull that power back. Hold 1200 ft-lb. That's shown at the top-left of the right-hand display.
chinese: 扭矩有点高，收点油门，保持 1200 英尺磅，右侧显示器左上角能看到。

english: You need some right rudder to counter that spiraling slip-stream of propwash racing around the airplane. Center that bar under the roll pointer at the top of your primary display.
chinese: 需要带点右舵，抵消螺旋桨洗流绕机身转造成的偏转。把主显示器顶部滚转指针下面那根条对中。

english: You got a bit too much right rudder. Ease off of it. Center that bar under the roll pointer at the top of your primary display.
chinese: 右舵给多了，松一点。把主显示器顶部滚转指针下面那根条对中。

english: Let's keep a heading of 150 degrees! That's on the bottom of your primary display.
chinese: 保持 150 度航向，在主显示器下方。

english: Yep. 120 knots, 1200 ft-lb, heading 150. Perfect!
Now, we have enough airspeed to counter-act full engine torque! It's time for full power! Advance the throttle until we've got 2,200 ft-lb of torque and raise that nose to hold 120 knots!
chinese: 现在速度够抵消全油门扭矩了，可以满功率！推油门到 2200 英尺磅，机头抬起来保持 120 节！

english: You're a bit slow. Lower that nose a bit so we can build up some speed. I want 120 knots. That's enroute climb.
chinese: 有点慢，机头压低一点加点速。我要 120 节，这是航路爬升。

english: You're going too fast. Get that nose UP to slow us down. I want 120 knots. That's enroute climb.
chinese: 太快了，机头抬一点减速。我要 120 节，这是航路爬升。

english: Torque's falling off as we climb into thinner air! Advance power to give me 2,200 ft-lb. That's the top-left of the right-hand display.
chinese: 爬升到稀薄空气里扭矩会掉！加油门给我 2200 英尺磅，右侧显示器左上角。

english: Torque's a bit high. Pull that power back. Give me 2,200 ft-lb. If you go more than 2,200 ft-lb of torque, you're gonna break the transmission to the propeller!
chinese: 扭矩有点高，收油门，给我 2200 英尺磅。超过 2200 就会打坏螺旋桨传动！

english: Right rudder to counter that spiraling slip-stream from the prop. Center that bar under the roll pointer at the top of your primary display.
chinese: 带右舵抵消螺旋桨洗流。把主显示器顶部滚转指针下面那根条对中。

english: I want a heading of 150 degrees! Heading indicator is at the bottom of your primary display.
chinese: 我要 150 度航向，航向指示器在主显示器下方。

english: Yep. 120 knots, 2,200 ft-lb, heading 150. This is the enroute climb!
chinese: 对，120 节、2200 英尺磅、航向 150，航路爬升！

english: Hold 800 ITT, 120 knots
Now, the air is too thin for maximum torque! We're now temperature-limited! Adjust throttle to hold 800 ITT! That's the second item down on the right-side display!
chinese: 现在空气太稀，最大扭矩受限了！变成温度限制！调油门保持 800 ITT，右侧显示器第二项！

english: You're going too fast. Get that nose ip to slow us down. I want 120 knots. That's enroute climb.
chinese: 太快了，机头抬一点减速。我要 120 节，这是航路爬升。

english: ITT is a bit low. Add some power. Give me 800 degrees.
chinese: ITT 有点低，加点油门，给我 800 度。

english: With thin air for cooling, ITT is high! Pull the power back! Give me 800 degrees. I don't wanna melt this engine!
chinese: 空气稀薄散热差，ITT 高了！收油门！给我 800 度，别把发动机烧了！

english: Right rudder to counter that spiraling slip-stream. Center that bar under the roll pointer!
chinese: 带右舵抵消螺旋桨洗流。把滚转指针下面那根条对中！

english: You got a bit too much right rudder. Ease off of it. Center that bar under the roll pointer!
chinese: 右舵给多了，松一点。把滚转指针下面那根条对中！

english: Heading of 150 degrees, please!
chinese: 航向 150，谢谢！

english: 120 knots, Turbine Inlet Temperature 800 degrees Celcius. Perfect. Hold this. Now you're gonna see that as we climb into thinner air, the torque is gonna fall off.
chinese: 120 节、涡轮进气温度 800 摄氏度，完美。保持住。接下来你会看到：爬进稀薄空气，扭矩会掉。

english: Hold 16,000 feet, 60 degrees
OK level us off here at 16,000 feet, set 1,200 ft-lb torque
chinese: 好，在 16000 英尺改平，扭矩设 1200 英尺磅。

english: OK let's try some steep turns. Give me 60 degrees of bank to the left. Hold 16,000 feet, 1,200 ft-lb of torque.
chinese: 好，练大坡度盘旋。左坡度 60 度，保持 16000 英尺、1200 英尺磅。

english: Get those wings over to the left. I want 60 degrees of bank to the left.
chinese: 把机翼压向左，我要左坡度 60 度。

english: Get those wings back closer to level. I want 60 degrees of bank to the left.
chinese: 把机翼改回接近水平，我要左坡度 60 度。

english: You're low. Pull up. I want 16,000 feet even in the turns.
chinese: 低了，拉起来，转弯时也要 16000 英尺。

english: You're high. Get that nose down. I want 16,000 feet even in the turns.
chinese: 高了，机头压低，转弯时也要 16000 英尺。

english: Right rudder! Center that bar under the roll pointery.
chinese: 右舵！把滚转指针下面那根条对中。

english: Left rudder! Center that bar under the roll pointer.
chinese: 左舵！把滚转指针下面那根条对中。

english: OK this looks good. Hold 60-left and 16,000 feet, 1,200 ft-lb torque. This is 2 G's.
chinese: 好，很稳。保持左 60、16000 英尺、1200 英尺磅。这是 2G。

english: OK let's try a steep right steep turn. Give me 60 degrees bank to the right. Hold 16,000 feet, 1,200 torque.
chinese: 好，练大坡度右转。右坡度 60 度，保持 16000 英尺、1200 扭矩。

english: Get those wings over to the right. I want 60 degrees of bank.
chinese: 把机翼压向右，我要 60 度坡度。

english: Get those wings back closer to level. I want 60 degrees of bank.
chinese: 把机翼改回接近水平，我要 60 度坡度。

english: Right rudder! Center that bar under the roll pointer!
chinese: 右舵！把滚转指针下面那根条对中！

english: Left rudder! Center that bar under the roll pointer!
chinese: 左舵！把滚转指针下面那根条对中！

english: OK this looks good. Hold 60-right and 16,000 feet, 1,200 ft-lb torque! 2 G's, baby!
chinese: 好，很稳。保持右 60、16000 英尺、1200 英尺磅！2G，爽吧！

english: Hold 16,000 feet, 330 degrees
OK now level it off and hold 16,000 ft, heading 330!
chinese: 好，改平保持 16000 英尺，航向 330！

english: Now, we're gonna do something fun!
chinese: 接下来玩点有意思的！

english: We're going to find out what the prop, flaps, and gear do to the drag on this airplane!
chinese: 我们来试试螺旋桨、襟翼和起落架对阻力有什么影响！

english: Pull the power to idle! Leave the gear and flaps up! I'm keeping the red condition lever at low idle.
chinese: 油门收到慢车！起落架和襟翼别动！红色状态杆我放在低慢车。

english: Descend at 110 knots
chinese: 以 110 节下降

english: Now feather the prop! Bring the big blue knob all the way back! Hit [sim/general/rot_up] / [sim/general/rot_down] or right-drag to look down!
chinese: 现在把螺旋桨顺桨！蓝色大手柄拉到最底！按 [sim/general/rot_up] / [sim/general/rot_down] 或右键拖动往下看！

english: Just hold the wings level! Power-off!
chinese: 保持机翼水平！收油门！

english: You're going bit fast! Raise the nose for 110 knots, that's the best glide speed!
chinese: 有点快！抬头保持 110 节，这是最佳滑翔速度！

english: You're going bit slow! Lower the nose for 110 knots, that's the best glide speed!
chinese: 有点慢！低头保持 110 节，这是最佳滑翔速度！

english: Perfect! 110 knots, best glide speed, power-off! Look how shallow our descent is! That's because this plane has almost no drag!
chinese: 完美！110 节、最佳滑翔、收油门！看下降多平缓！因为这架飞机阻力几乎为零！

english: Now redline the prop! Bring the big blue knob all the way forwards! This is gonna turn the prop into a speedbrake!
chinese: 现在把螺旋桨拉到最高转速！蓝色手柄推到最前！螺旋桨就变成减速板了！

english: A bit fast! Raise the nose for 110 knots.
chinese: 有点快！抬头保持 110 节。

english: A bit slow! Lower the nose for 110 knots.
chinese: 有点慢！低头保持 110 节。

english: Now we're coming down steeper, because of the drag of that huge propeller! The propeller is an airbrake when there's no power going into it!
chinese: 现在下降更陡了，因为大螺旋桨的阻力！不供油时它就是个空气刹车！

english: Now, lower the flaps all the way! Hit the [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] key twice!
chinese: 现在把襟翼全放下来！按两次 [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] 键！

english: You're a bit fast! Raise the nose for 110 knots!
chinese: 有点快！抬头保持 110 节！

english: You're a bit slow! Lower the nose for 110 knots!
chinese: 有点慢！低头保持 110 节！

english: Now we're coming down even steeper, because of the drag of those huge flaps!
chinese: 现在更陡了，因为大襟翼的阻力！

english: Now lower the gear! [sim/flight_controls/landing_gear_toggle] key!
chinese: 放起落架！[sim/flight_controls/landing_gear_toggle] 键！

english: Just hold the wings level! Power off!
chinese: 保持机翼水平！收油门！

english: A bit fast! Raise the nose for 110 knots!
chinese: 有点快！抬头保持 110 节！

english: A bit slow! Lower the nose for 110 knots!
chinese: 有点慢！低头保持 110 节！

english: Now we're coming down even steeper, because of the drag of that landing gear! That's twice the drag of the entire airplane!
chinese: 现在更陡了，因为起落架的阻力！那可是整架飞机阻力的两倍！

english: Whew! OK, get this bird set to fly! Prop forwards! Add power! Gear up! Flaps up!
chinese: 呼！恢复飞行！螺旋桨推前！加油门！收起落架！收襟翼！

english: Now you see how you can glide really well... or add a ton of drag to descend really steep!
chinese: 现在你知道了：可以滑翔得很远……也可以靠阻力陡降！

english: Use this information to either glide efficiently or slam-dunk a descent!
chinese: 用这些技巧，要么高效滑翔，要么一口气陡降下来！

english: OK go to LOWS runway 15 with the map and land. I'm just gonna score your touch-down!
chinese: 好，看地图飞到 LOWS 15 号跑道降落，我只给你的接地打分！

english: That was way too fast. That's hard on the tires and it causes this airplane to float.
chinese: 太快了，费轮胎，飞机还会飘。

english: That was too fast. That's hard on the tires and floats the plane.
chinese: 太快了，费轮胎，飞机也会飘。

english: That was fast. That's hard on the tires and increases stopping distance.
chinese: 快了，费轮胎，刹车距离变长。

english: That was a bit fast. That increases stopping distance.
chinese: 有点快，刹车距离会变长。

english: That was terrible.
chinese: 太差劲了。

english: Pretty hard landing.
chinese: 落地挺重。

english: That was a bit rough.
chinese: 有点颠。

english: Not too bad I guess.
chinese: 还算可以吧。

english: Pretty decent I guess.
chinese: 相当不错。

english: Oh yeah! Now that's how you land this thing.
chinese: 哎对！这才是落地的方式

english: All right your airplane. I'm out.
chinese: 好，飞机归你了，我撤。

english: Let's get going. Gimme one notch of flaps.
chinese: 走起吧，放一档襟翼。

english: [sim/flight_controls/mrakes_toggle_regular] key for brakes off!
chinese: 按 [sim/flight_controls/mrakes_toggle_regular] 松刹车！

english: Power for 1200 ft-lb of torque. That's half power so we don't run out of rudder authority.
chinese: 油门到 1200 英尺磅扭矩，半功率，免得方向舵不够用。

english: Nose 10 degrees up! That's a bit faster than best-angle-of-climb speed, so we don't run out of aileron authority!
chinese: 机头 10 度上仰！比最佳爬升角稍快，免得副翼不够用！

english: Nose 10 degrees up! Gear up!
chinese: 10 度上仰！收起落架

english: Flaps up! 120 knots! 150 degree heading!
chinese: 收襟翼！120 节！航向 150！

english: Now we have enough speed to counter-act full engine torque! Give me 2,200 ft-lb of torque and hold 120 knots!
chinese: 现在速度够抵消全油门扭矩了！给我 2200 英尺磅，保持 120 节！

english: Looks like your airspeed sensor failed. That's actually happened to me before.
chinese: 你的空速管好像坏了。这事我真遇上过。

english: Assuming you don't have Xavion to back up your airspeed, fly 20 degrees pitch to 28,000 feet, heading 150.
chinese: 假设你没有 Xavion 备份空速，就用 20 度俯仰爬到 28000 英尺，航向 150。

english: That nose is too low. Raise it. Climb at 20 degrees pitch since you don't have airspeed.
chinese: 机头太低了，抬起来。没有空速就按 20 度俯仰爬升。

english: That nose is too high. Lower it. Climb at 20 degrees pitch since you don't have airspeed.
chinese: 机头太高了，压下去。没有空速就按 20 度俯仰爬升。

english: Torque's falling off as we climb into thinner air! Give me 2,200 ft-lb.
chinese: 爬进稀薄空气，扭矩会掉！给我 2200 英尺磅。

english: Torque's a bit high. Pull power back. Give me 2,200 ft-lb. I don't want you breaking the transmission!
chinese: 扭矩有点高，收油门。给我 2200 英尺磅，别把传动打坏了！

english: Right rudder to counter that spiraling slip-stream from the prop. Center that bar under the roll pointer.
chinese: 带右舵抵消螺旋桨洗流。把滚转指针下面那根条对中。

english: Less right rudder! Center that bar under the roll pointer.
chinese: 右舵少一点！把滚转指针下面那根条对中。

english: I want a heading of 150 degrees!
chinese: 我要 150 度航向！

english: Yep. 20 degrees pitch, 2,200 ft-lb, heading 150. Ignore the malfunctioning airspeed!
chinese: 对，20 度俯仰、2200 英尺磅、航向 150。别管那坏掉的空速表！

english: Air's now too thin for maximum torque! Adjust power to hold 800 ITT! Lower nose to 15 degrees pitch!
chinese: 空气太稀，最大扭矩不够了！调油门保持 800 ITT！机头降到 15 度俯仰！

english: That nose is too low. Raise it. Climb at 15 degrees pitch since you don't have an airspeed indicator.
chinese: 机头太低了，抬起来。没有空速表就按 15 度俯仰爬。

english: That nose is too high. Lower it. Climb at 15 degrees pitch since you don't have an airspeed indicator.
chinese: 机头太高了，压下去。没有空速表就按 15 度俯仰爬。

english: ITT is a bit low. Add power. Give me 800 degrees.
chinese: ITT 有点低，加油门，给我 800 度。

english: ITT is high with thin air for cooling! Pull power back! Give me 800 degrees. I dont wanna melt the engine.
chinese: 空气稀薄散热差，ITT 高了！收油门！给我 800 度，别把发动机烧了。

english: Right rudder to counter that spiraling slip-stream from the prop. Center that bar under the roll pointer!
chinese: 带右舵抵消螺旋桨洗流。把滚转指针下面那根条对中！

english: Ease off that right rudder. Center that bar under the roll pointer!
chinese: 右舵松一点。把滚转指针下面那根条对中！

english: 15 degrees pitch, ITT 800 degrees Celcius to 28,000 feet. Perfect. Ignore that malfunctioning airspeed!
chinese: 15 度俯仰、ITT 800 摄氏度爬到 28000 英尺，完美。别管那坏掉的空速表！

english: We just had a cabin de-pressurization! This has happened to me as well!!!
chinese: 我们刚刚座舱失压了！这事我也遇上过！！！

english: Emergency descent! Power to idle! Roll right to 60 degrees! Nose 10 degrees down!
chinese: 紧急下降！油门收慢车！右压 60 度！机头下 10 度！

english: OK we're down to 12,500 feet! That's low enough to breathe without cabin pressurization!
chinese: 好，降到 12500 英尺了！不增压也能呼吸了！

english: I think we may be getting ice on this thing... this has also happend to me before...
chinese: 我感觉机上在结冰……这事我也遇上过……

english: Establish low cruise back to the airport! Set 1000 ft-lb of torque, 12,500 feet, heading 330.
chinese: 建立低速巡航回机场！扭矩 1000 英尺磅、12500 英尺、航向 330。

english: We're having compressor stalls! That's also happened to me before!
chinese: 压气机失速了！这事我也遇上过！

english: I'm pulling power to idle to protect the engine! You have to land at LOWS ruynway 15, power-off!
chinese: 我收油门保护发动机！你得在 LOWS 15 号跑道无动力降落！

english: And I'm gonna grade you on your landing, same as always!
chinese: 着陆我还是照常给你打分！

english: Remember what you can do with the flaps, gear, and prop to adjust your glide ratio! We practiced this on the last flight!
chinese: 记住怎么用襟翼、起落架和螺旋桨调滑翔比！上一班我们练过！

english: I'm scoring for touchdown at LOWS runway 15.
chinese: 我在 LOWS 15 号跑道给接地打分。

english: You were going way too fast! You'll never this bird stopped!
chinese: 你太快了！这飞机根本停不下来！

english: You were going too fast! Why slam down so soon and drag the brakes forever?
chinese: 太快了！干嘛这么急砸下去然后一路刹车？

english: You were going fast! Slow down with the wings, not with the brakes!
chinese: 快了！用机翼减速，别靠刹车！

english: Well that sucked.
chinese: 太糟了。

english: Not too bad.
chinese: 还不错。

english: Pretty decent.
chinese: 挺不错。

english: OK that was a pretty good touch-down! Pretty, pretty, pretty good!
chinese: 好，这一下接地挺漂亮！相当、相当、相当漂亮！

english: Well I guess we're still alive. Your airplane!
chinese: 看来我们还活着。飞机归你了！

english: All right let's take this thing up to Mach 0.5.
chinese: 好，我们把这家伙拉到 0.5 马赫。

english: We're gonna go cold and dark to half the speed of sound at 28,000 feet.
chinese: 我们从冷舱状态一路爬到 28000 英尺、半音速。

english: Destination LOWI: That's Innsbruck, Austria. I got some more gas in this thing so it'll feel a bit heavier. It's also gonna have more inertia in roll.
chinese: 目的地 LOWI：奥地利的因斯布鲁克。这次油更多，会更沉，滚转惯性也更大。

english: Lemme show you the approach we're gonna fly. Pop this open in a web browser if you can. Or maybe the same URL on a laptop or iPad.
chinese: 我给你看看我们要飞的进近图。能用浏览器打开就打开，或者用笔记本、iPad 打开同一链接。

english: OK you got the Approach Plate. Now battery switches BAT 1 and BAT 2 on the upper left of the panel.
chinese: 好，进近图有了。现在按面板左上角的 BAT 1 和 BAT 2 电瓶开关。

english: Now DC POWER button right below the BAT 2.
chinese: 按 BAT 2 正下方的 DC POWER 按钮。

english: DOOR SEALS button on the very lower-left of the panel. Let's seal up this cabin.
chinese: 面板最左下角的 DOOR SEALS 按钮，把座舱封起来。

english: Igniters, the next switch over from the door-seals.
chinese: 点火开关，就在门封旁边那个。

english: So we got spark in the engine. Now hit the fuel pumps.
chinese: 发动机点火了。现在按燃油泵。

english: OK we need that turbine to form an insulating wall of air between the combustion chamber and the engine case before we add fuel!!!
chinese: 加燃油前，得让涡轮在燃烧室和机匣之间形成一层隔热空气墙！！！

english: OK push the blue knob at the bottom of the panel all the way forwards. [sim/general/rot_down] key to look down if you need to.
chinese: 好，把面板下方的蓝色手柄推到最前。需要的话按 [sim/general/rot_down] 往下看。

english: Generator and alternator on. Those switches are just below the batteries!
chinese: 发电机和交流发电机接通，开关就在电瓶下面！

english: Hit the NAV and STROBE and LANDING LIGHTS, they're just to the right of the starter.
chinese: 按 NAV、STROBE 和 LANDING LIGHTS，就在启动按钮右边。

english: Time for pressurization. Hit the BLEED AIR button to the right of the lights to get high pressure air out of the engine and into the cabin.
chinese: 该增压了。按灯右边的 BLEED AIR 按钮，把发动机高压引气送进座舱。

english: Headsets on. One notch of flaps. Hit the [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] key or hit the flap lever to get one notch of flaps for me.
chinese: 耳机戴好。放一档襟翼，按 [sim/flight_controls/flaps_down] 键或者拨襟翼手柄，给我放一档。

english: Hit [sim/view/default_view] or right-mouse-drag to get your view set for take-off, then brakes off!
chinese: 按 [sim/view/default_view] 或右键拖动设好起飞视角，然后松刹车！

english: Add power to get 1200 ft-lb of torque. That's about half power so we don't run out of rudder authority as that prop pulls us off to the left! Torque indicator is upper-left on the MFD, or Multi-Function Display, which is the right-side display.
chinese: 加油门到 1200 英尺磅扭矩，大约半功率，免得螺旋桨把飞机往左带、方向舵不够！扭矩表在 MFD（右侧多功能显示器）左上角。

english: Start the nose up at 60 knots. I gonna want 10 degrees up.
chinese: 60 节开始抬头，我要 10 度上仰。

english: I want 10 degrees nose-up. That's a little faster than best-angle of climb, that's a little extra speed so we don't run out of rudder and aileron authority!
chinese: 我要 10 度上仰。比最佳爬升角稍快一点，多留点速度，免得方向舵和副翼不够用！

english: 50 feet: Gear up!
chinese: 50英尺：收轮

english: 200 feet: Flaps up! Hold 10 degrees nose-up, heading 250!
chinese: 200 英尺：收襟翼，10 度上仰，航向 250！

english: Lets get that nose up! I want 10 degrees of pitch to build up a bit of airspeed, please.
chinese: 把机头抬起来！我要 10 度俯仰，好把速度提起来。

english: Lower that nose! I want 10 degrees of pitch to build up a bit of speed.
chinese: 机头压低！我要 10 度俯仰，好把速度提起来。

english: Torque's falling off as we climb into thinner air! Advance that throttle to hold 1200 ft-lb. That's at the top-left of the right-hand display.
chinese: 爬进稀薄空气扭矩会掉！推油门保持 1200 英尺磅，右侧显示器左上角。

english: Torque's a bit high. Pull that power back. Hold 1200 ft-lb. That's at the top-left of the right-hand display.
chinese: 扭矩有点高，收点油门。保持 1200 英尺磅，右侧显示器左上角。

english: You need some right rudder to counter that spiraling slip-stream of propwash racing around the airplane. Center that bar under the roll pointer at the top of your primary display. I strongly advise you assign joystick buttons to yaw trim to trim out the sidelsip in the climb!
chinese: 需要带点右舵，抵消螺旋桨洗流绕机身转的偏转。把主显示器顶部滚转指针下面那根条对中。强烈建议给摇杆按钮分配偏航配平，把爬升中的侧滑配掉！

english: You got a bit too much right rudder. Ease off of it. Center that bar under the roll pointer at the top of your primary display. I really suggest you assign joystick buttons to yaw trim to trim out the sidelsip!
chinese: 右舵给多了，松一点。把主显示器顶部滚转指针下面那根条对中。真的建议给摇杆按钮分配偏航配平，把侧滑配掉！

english: Let's keep a heading of 250 degrees! That's on the bottom of your primary display.
chinese: 保持 250 度航向，在主显示器下方。

english: Yep. 1200 ft-lb, 10 degrees pitch, heading 250. Perfect!
chinese: 对，1200 英尺磅、10 度俯仰、航向 250！

english: All right, we now have enough airspeed to counter-act full engine torque! It's time for full power! Advance that throttle until we've got 2,200 ft-lb of torque and let's climb at 140 knots.
chinese: 好，现在速度够抵消全油门扭矩了！可以满功率！推油门到 2200 英尺磅，以 140 节爬升。

english: You're a bit slow. Lower that nose a bit so we can build up some speed. I want 140 knots enroute climb.
chinese: 有点慢，机头压低一点加点速。我要 140 节航路爬升。

english: You're going too fast. Get that nose UP to slow us down. I want 140 knots enroute climb. The thick air way down here is giving us tons of power!
chinese: 太快了，机头抬一点减速。我要 140 节航路爬升。下面这厚空气给足了功率！

english: The torque's falling off as we climb up into thinner air! So advance power to give me 2,200 ft-lb. That's the top-left of the right-hand display.
chinese: 爬进稀薄空气扭矩会掉！加油门给我 2200 英尺磅，右侧显示器左上角。

english: Torque's a bit high. Pull that power back. Give me 2,200 ft-lb. If you go more than 2,200 ft-lb of torque, you're gonna break the transmission to the prop!
chinese: 扭矩有点高，收油门。给我 2200 英尺磅，超过就会打坏螺旋桨传动！

english: Right rudder to counter that spiraling slip-stream from the prop. Center that bar under the roll pointer at the top of your primary display. If you got any joystick buttons, assign them to yaw trim!
chinese: 带右舵抵消螺旋桨洗流。把主显示器顶部滚转指针下面那根条对中。有摇杆按钮就分配给偏航配平！

english: I want a heading of 250 degrees! The heading indicator is at the bottom of your primary display.
chinese: 我要 250 度航向！航向指示器在主显示器下方。

english: Yep. 140 knots, 2,200 ft-lb, heading 250. This is the enroute climb! Now you're going to lower the nose for a shallower climb as we go up into the thinner air and the engine makes less power!
chinese: 对，140 节、2200 英尺磅、航向 250，这就是航路爬升！接下来空气变稀、功率变小，你要压低机头用更平缓的爬升。

english: I'm dialing LOWI into the G1000 for you. Follow the magenta line on the right-side G1000 to LOWI as you climb. We'll be going to 28,000 feet!
chinese: 我在 G1000 里给你调出 LOWI。沿着右侧 G1000 的品红线爬到 LOWI，高度 28000 英尺！

english: Now the air's is too thin up here to hold maximum torque! We're now limited by the allowable temperature! Adjust the throttle to hold 800 degrees Inlet to Turbine Temperature. That's the second item down on the right-side display!
chinese: 这里空气太稀，保持不了最大扭矩！现在受温度限制！调油门保持涡轮进口温度 800 度，右侧显示器第二项！

english: You gotta lower the nose as we climb into thinner air and can't climb up so steep any more! I want 140 knots.
chinese: 空气变稀，爬不了那么陡了，机头得压下去！我要 140 节。

english: You're going too fast. Get that nose up to slow us down. I want 140 knots.
chinese: 太快了，机头抬一点减速。我要 140 节。

english: That ITT is a bit low. Add some power. Give me 800 degrees.
chinese: ITT 有点低，加油门，给我 800 度。

english: Up in this thin air with little cooling, that ITT is high! Pull the power back! Give me 800 degrees. I don't wanna melt this engine!
chinese: 高空空气稀薄散热差，ITT 高了！收油门！给我 800 度，别把发动机烧了！

english: Right rudder to counter that spiraling slip-stream. Center that bar under the roll pointer! Joystick buttons assigned to yaw trim will help you out a lot.
chinese: 带右舵抵消螺旋桨洗流。把滚转指针下面那根条对中！给摇杆按钮分配偏航配平会帮大忙。

english: You got a bit too much right rudder. Ease off of it. Center that bar under the roll pointer! Remember joystick buttons assigned to yaw trim will really help you out here.
chinese: 右舵给多了，松一点。把滚转指针下面那根条对中！记住，摇杆按钮分配偏航配平在这里很有用。

english: Fly the magenta enroute line on the map... That's also shown as a deflection on the HSI right in the bottom-center of your primary display. Keep that near-vertical line centered in the middle of the heading ring.
chinese: 跟着地图上的品红航路飞……主显示器正下方 HSI 上的偏移也会显示。把那根近乎竖直的线保持在航向环中间。

english: A really important thing to know about high-altitude flight is descent planning. Once we get to cruise altitude, we'll be at 28,000 ft, and I like to descend at 2,000 feet per minute, so we need to make sure we start our descent when we're still 14 minutes out!
chinese: 高空飞行很重要的一点是下降规划。巡航高度 28000 英尺，我喜欢 2000 英尺/分下降，所以得在还有 14 分钟航程时就开始下降！

english: OOOH! I found some Salt-n-Vinegar chips!!! My favorite! You mind if I have them now? (munch munch munch)
chinese: 哦！我找到盐醋薯片了！！！我的最爱！不介意我现在吃吧？（咔嚓咔嚓）

english: Baaaybbbbeeeeee shark do-do-dee-do-do-do Baby shark do-do-dee-do-do-do Baby shark do-do-dee-do-do-do Baby SHARK! Oh sorry.
chinese: 鲨鱼宝宝嘟嘟嘟嘟……鲨鱼宝宝嘟嘟嘟嘟……鲨鱼宝宝！哦抱歉。

english: You ever see a movie called The Patent Scam? It's a movie I made about Patent Trolls... It's on Amazon Prime! This airplane is in the movie. You should see it it's really good.
chinese: 你看过《The Patent Scam》吗？我拍的关于专利流氓的片子……Amazon Prime 上有！这架飞机也出镜了，值得一看，真的不错。

english: Doo dee do dee doo de dooo.
chinese: 嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟……

english: Yawn.
chinese: Zzz

english: 140 knots, Turbine Inlet Temperature 800 degrees Celcius. Perfect. Hold this. Now we're gonna see that as we climb into thinner though, the torque is going to fall off.
chinese: 140 节、涡轮进气温度 800 摄氏度，完美。保持住。接下来你会看到：爬进稀薄空气，扭矩会掉。

english: OK level off here at 28,000 feet! That's as high as we can go without needing autopilot certification requirements that this airplane could never meet! Also higher than this, the air gets so thin that I would never trust the pressurization system!
chinese: 好，在 28000 英尺改平！这是我们的上限——再高就要自动驾驶认证，这架飞机根本达不到！而且再高空气太稀，我不信它的增压系统。

english: Now we need to slow the prop down to keep its' tip speed below the speed of sound so shock-waves don't build up and ruin our efficiency! So pull the blue knob back a bit to set the prop to 1800 RPM, and pull the throttle back a bit to set 750 ITT and that'll give us a medium cruise.
chinese: 现在要把螺旋桨转速降下来，让桨尖速度低于音速，免得产生激波、效率变差。蓝色手柄往回拉一点，转速设 1800 RPM；油门收一点，ITT 设 750，这就是中等巡航。

english: Give me 28,000 feet within 200 feet. You gottta fly to IFR tolerances up here.
chinese: 保持 28000 英尺，误差 200 英尺内。这里要按仪表标准飞。

english: Give me 1800 RPM to keep those prop tips below the speed of sound.
chinese: 给我 1800 RPM，让桨尖速度低于音速。

english: ITT is a bit low. Add some power. Give me 750 degrees. Let's get this thing moving to Innsbruck.
chinese: ITT 有点低，加点油门，给我 750 度，让这家伙往因斯布鲁克赶！

english: With so little air for cooling up here, that ITT is high! Pull the power back! Give me 750 degrees. I don't wanna melt this engine!
chinese: 这里空气少、散热差，ITT 高了！收油门！给我 750 度，别把发动机烧了！

english: Now with all this speed and not nearly so much spiraling slip-stream, we don't need all that right rudder! Center that bar under the roll pointer!
chinese: 现在速度快了、螺旋桨洗流小了，不需要那么多右舵！把滚转指针下面那根条对中！

english: Fly the magenta enroute line on the map... That's also shown as a deflection on the HSI right in the bottom-center of your primary flight display. Keep that near-vertical line centered in the middle of the heading ring.
chinese: 跟着地图上的品红航路飞……主飞行显示器正下方 HSI 的偏移也会显示。把那根近乎竖直的线保持在航向环中间。

english: Yup. Flight Level 280, 1800 RPM, 750 ITT, on course. Perfect.
chinese: 对，280 高度层、1800 RPM、ITT 750，航路正确。

english: Cool! We busted through Mach 0.5. Oh crap we're late for our descend into Innsbruck! We should've planned our descent better!
chinese: 酷！我们突破了 0.5 马赫。糟了，下降因斯布鲁克要迟到了！下降规划没做好！

english: All right I'm selecting the GPS approach to runway 26 for you. Track the magenta line on the MFD, or center the CDI on the PFD! The CDI is little magenta vertical line on the bottom-center of your primary flight display. Steer the plane towards the deflection to keep it centered!
chinese: 好，我给你选 26 号跑道的 GPS 进近。跟着 MFD 的品红线，或者把 CDI 对中！CDI 是主飞行显示器正下方那根细品红线，往偏移方向打杆把它对中！

english: You'll have to slam-dunk the descend since we got on top of the approach before we figured out where we were! This is turning out to be a lesson in what not to do!!
chinese: 我们到进近点才发现自己在哪，只能一口气砸下去——这堂课就是教你「别这么干」！！

english: Give me power off, 4,000 feet per minute down to 9,500 feet! Follow the lateral CDI! The CDI is bottom-center on your left-side display. If the CDI wanders left, aim left to re-center it! If the CDI wanders right, aim right to re-center it!
chinese: 收油门，4000 英尺/分下降到 9500 英尺！跟着水平 CDI！CDI 在左侧显示器正下方。偏左就往左打，偏右就往右打，把它对中！

english: Keep us on course! Keep us on that magenta line on the MFD, or keep that CDI centered on the PFD. We're rapidly descending into mountainous terrain! Stay on course... or we die!
chinese: 别偏离航路！跟着 MFD 上的品红线，或者把 PFD 上的 CDI 对中。我们正在山区急速下降！偏了……就没命了！

english: Get that throttle back to idle! We gotta slam dunk this descent since we didn't plan ahead. Of course, going throttle to idle will cause the cabin to de-pressurize a bit, so get your oxygen mask ready.
chinese: 油门收回慢车！没提前规划，只能硬砸下去。当然，收慢车座舱会失压一点，氧气面罩准备好。

english: 4,000 feet per minute down, please. We gotta get this thing down to start the approach. Just don't tell anyone we got so far behind the airplane, OK?
chinese: 4000 英尺/分下降，谢谢。得赶紧下去开始进近。别跟别人说我们落后飞机这么多，行吗？

english: Keep this plane coordinated! Center the side-slip indicator on the PFD. We might need left rudder now that we have no spiraling slipstream from the prop! Remember the tail on this thing is canted a bit to be set up for the spiral slip-stream we get in cruise, and now, at idle, we have no prop slip-stream at all, so we might even need a little left rudder!
chinese: 保持协调！把 PFD 上的侧滑指示对中。现在没螺旋桨洗流，可能要带点左舵！这架飞机垂尾是偏置的，为的就是巡航时的螺旋桨洗流；现在慢车没洗流了，可能得带点左舵！

english: OK stay the course down to 9,500 feet at 4,000 feet per minute to start the approach. I'm... kind of gritting my teeth for both of us over here. Obviously, we should have planned our descent better based on our altitude, speed, and distance to destination.
chinese: 好，保持 4000 英尺/分下降到 9500 英尺，开始进近。我……替咱俩咬牙呢。显然，按高度、速度、距离，我们本该早点规划下降。

english: OK we're at the initial approach fix altitude of 9,500 feet. Hold 9,500 feet until the Initial Approach Fix: WI610! Hold the lateral CDI centered, speed your discretion.
chinese: 好，到了起始进近定位点高度 9500 英尺。保持 9500 直到 WI610！水平 CDI 保持居中，速度自定。

english: Now quickly hold 7,200 feet until WI611! Hold the lateral CDI centered, speed your discretion.
chinese: 现在尽快保持 7200 英尺直到 WI611！水平 CDI 居中，速度自定。

english: Now quickly hold 6,300 feet until WI612! Hold the lateral CDI centered, speed your discretion.
chinese: 现在尽快保持 6300 英尺直到 WI612！水平 CDI 居中，速度自定。

english: Now quickly hold 5,750 feet until WI613! Hold the lateral CDI centered, speed your discretion. Get ready to grab the vertical CDI when it pops up! It will ppear on the right side of the artificial horizon.
chinese: 现在尽快保持 5750 英尺直到 WI613！水平 CDI 居中，速度自定。准备好抓垂直 CDI，它一出现就抓！它会在人工地平线右侧出现。

english: Boom. We passed WI613, now follow the vertical CDI to the runway! It's on the right side of the artificial horizon. If it moves up above the center, fly the plane up to grab it! If it moves down below the center, fly down!
chinese: 砰。过了 WI613，现在跟着垂直 CDI 飞向跑道！它在人工地平线右侧。跑到中心上方就往上飞，跑到下方就往下飞！

english: You're wandering away from the lateral GPS course a bit... stay on that lateral GPS course down to 3,000 feet! That's the big needle on the HSI just under the horizon. Keep that centered!
chinese: 你有点偏离水平 GPS 航路了……回到航路，降到 3000 英尺！就是 HSI 上地平线下面那根大指针，把它对中！

english: You're off of the vertical GPS glidepath a bit... stay on that vertical GPS glidepath down to 3,000 feet! It's the little pointer just to the right of the horizon. Keep that centered!
chinese: 你有点偏离垂直 GPS 下滑道……保持住，降到 3000 英尺！就是地平线右边那个小指针，把它对中！

english: Now I want maximum RPM for precise speed control and the ability to miss an approach! Give me 2,000 prop RPM! That's blue-knob all the way forwards.
chinese: 现在我要最大转速，方便精确控速、也方便复飞！给我 2000 螺旋桨 RPM！蓝色手柄推到最前。

english: Keep this thing coordinated! We want to cancel the spiraling slip-stream from the prop with rudder!
chinese: 保持协调！用舵抵消螺旋桨洗流！

english: Keep calm and carry on.
chinese: 保持冷静继续飞

english: OK I got the runway. You can leave the GPS path to fly the approach visually as you like.
chinese: 好，我看到跑道了。你可以脱离 GPS 航路，目视进近。

english: You were going way too fast. That's hard on the tires and it makes the airplane float forever on the wing.
chinese: 太快了，费轮胎，飞机还会一直飘。

english: You were going too fast. That's hard on the tires and it makes you float down the runway on the wing.
chinese: 太快了，费轮胎，飞机会飘着跑完跑道。

english: You were going a bit fast. Remember that increases your stopping distance.
chinese: 有点快，记住这会拉长刹车距离。

english: Well that was a hard landing.
chinese: 落地挺重。

english: Pretty decent for smoothness there. I like it.
chinese: 平稳度相当不错，我喜欢。

english: OK get this thing slowed down and taxi on in.
chinese: 好，把速度降下来，滑进去。

english: Whew! OK so that, to me, was being behind the airplane. It's that thing that happens when you don't plan ahead enough and so you're always playing catch-up for the whole flight.
chinese: 呼！好，这就叫「落后于飞机」：没提前规划，整趟都在追赶。

english: All right there's ice forecast for up there today and 44X does NOT have wing de-ice!
chinese: 今天高空有结冰预报，而 44X 没有机翼除冰！

english: The de-ice would have been this big blocky thing on the leading edge of the wing and would have slowed me down so I didn't want it.
chinese: 除冰本该是机翼前缘那坨大块头，但那样会拖慢我，所以我没装。

english: BUT of course now with ice in the clouds... we can't fly.
chinese: 可现在云里有冰……我们飞不了。

english: But hey I got my Tesla here! It's a Model-3 Performance... why don't we take it for a drive instead?
chinese: 不过嘿，我把特斯拉开来了！Model 3 Performance……不如开它去兜一圈？

english: This thing is 4-wheel drive, does 0 to 60 in 2.9 seconds, and the only fluid it ever takes is windshield-wiper fluid.
chinese: 这车四驱，0 到 60 英里 2.9 秒，唯一的液体消耗就是玻璃水。

english: You take it! Drive wherever you want! Just shove the joystick forward for the 'gas'!
chinese: 你来开！随便开！把摇杆往前推就是「油门」！

english: Yah that's what this thing can do!
chinese: 对，这就是它的本事！

english: That's your 3-seconds to 60!
Oh that never gets old!
chinese: 哦，永远不腻！

english: That's what happens with 4-wheel drive and milli-second motor response for the traction control.
chinese: 四驱加上毫秒级电机响应和牵引力控制，就是这样。

english: (unintelligible)
chinese: （听不清）

english: A G of decel!
chinese: 1G 减速！

english: Yah the brakes work too.
chinese: 对，刹车也好使。

english: Yah scrub off that speed.)
chinese: 对，磨掉速度。）

english: Yah I've had this thing on the track and my lower back was sore from the G-load!
chinese: 对，我把这车开上过赛道，过弯 G 值把我腰都搞酸了！

english: Yah the cornering G is good, too.
chinese: 对，过弯 G 值也不错。

english: OK there's 100 knots.
OK there's 115 miles an hour.
chinese: 好，到 115 英里/时。

english: So we're no longer torque-limited from the motor, we're power-limited from the battery.
chinese: 现在不再受电机扭矩限制，而是受电池功率限制。

english: OK this speed's getting me a little nervous.
chinese: 好，这速度让我有点紧张。

english: OK maybe ease it down a bit.
chinese: 好，稍微收一点吧。
